title: Build Your Startup With AI: From Idea to Launch Without a Technical Co-Founder
summary: Build your startup with AI — go from idea to first paying customer without a technical co-founder. Step-by-step guide for non-technical founders in 2026.
body_markdown: Yes — and many founders are doing exactly that in 2026. AI app builders handle the infrastructure that used to require a technical co-founder: database, auth, hosting, and deployment. The skills that remain non-delegable are customer discovery, sales, and strategic judgment — none of which require coding ability. Jon Cheney built a $2.5M/year business with zero coding experience.
